verdict.rationale: Secureframe publishes a public REST API reference at api.secureframe.com/docs, built on JSON API conventions with Lucene search, request/response schemas for each endpoint group, an embedded OpenAPI 3.0 definition, and a dated-version backwards-compatibility policy. The marketing API page adds that the API can reach any existing object and push custom resources. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of real-world API use, and a separately documented raw OpenAPI spec download URL.
